1.text: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.

2.text: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?

3.text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.

4.text: You know the way to the place where I am going. ” The Way, the Truth, and the Life

6.text: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.

7.text: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”

9.text: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

10.text: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.

11.text: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me — or at least believe on account of the works themselves.

12.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.

13.text: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

14.text: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it. Jesus Promises the Holy Spirit ( John 16:5–16|JHN 16:5-16 )

15.text: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.

16.text: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever —

17.text: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.

18.text: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

19.text: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.

20.text: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.

21.text: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”

23.text: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.

24.text: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.

25.text: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.

26.text: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you. Peace I Leave with You

27.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

28.text: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.

29.text: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.

30.text: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.

31.text: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.’’

1.text: “ I am the true vine, and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard.

2.text: He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.

3.text: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.

4.text: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.

5.text: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.

6.text: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.

7.text: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.

8.text: This is to My Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples. No Greater Love

9.text: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.

10.text: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.

11.text: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.

12.text: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

13.text: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.

14.text: You are My friends if you do what I command you.

15.text: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.

16.text: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit — fruit that will remain — so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

17.text: This is My command to you: Love one another. The Hatred of the World

18.text: If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.

19.text: If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.

20.text: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.

21.text: But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.

22.text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.

23.text: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.

24.text: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.

25.text: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’

26.text: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father — the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father — He will testify about Me.

27.text: And you also must testify, because you have been with Me from the beginning.’’

1.text: “ I have told you these things so that you will not fall away.

2.text: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.

3.text: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.

4.text: But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you. The Promise of the Holy Spirit ( John 14:15–26|JHN 14:15-26 )

5.text: Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me; yet none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’

6.text: Instead, your hearts are filled with sorrow because I have told you these things.

7.text: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.

8.text: And when He comes, He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:

9.text: in regard to sin, because they do not believe in Me;

10.text: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see Me;

11.text: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.

12.text: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.

13.text: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.

14.text: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you.

15.text: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.

16.text: In a little while you will see Me no more, and then after a little while you will see Me. ” Grief Will Turn to Joy

19.text: Aware that they wanted to question Him, Jesus said to them, “Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?

20.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.

21.text: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.

22.text: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy. Ask in My Name ( Matthew 18:19–20|MAT 18:19-20 )

23.text: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

24.text: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.

25.text: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

26.text: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.

27.text: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.

28.text: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”

32.text: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.

33.text: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”

1.text: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.

2.text: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.

3.text: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.

4.text: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.

5.text: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed. Prayer for the Disciples

6.text: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.

7.text: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.

8.text: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.

9.text: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.

10.text: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.

11.text: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.

12.text: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.

13.text: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.

14.text: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them. For they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

15.text: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.

16.text: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

17.text: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.

18.text: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.

19.text: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth. Prayer for All Believers

20.text: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,

21.text: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.

22.text: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one —

23.text: I in them and You in Me — that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.

24.text: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.

25.text: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.

26.text: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”
